psychological_meaning: Patina, often associated with aged copper and bronze, evokes feelings of history, wisdom, and timeless beauty. It blends the tranquility of green with the stability of blue, suggesting a calming yet enduring presence. This color can represent growth, resilience, and a connection to the past, reminding us of the value in weathering challenges and embracing change.
